style: Warm editorial, confident and trustworthy Norwegian medical-clinic brand piece. Light background (not the usual dark motion-graphics default), serif headlines paired with geometric sans body, real vector icon motifs (calendar/pages, building, phone, checkmark) — not decorative-only. One continuous camera current across all 5 scenes: each exit motivates the next entrance. No people, no faces, no medical claims beyond 'specialist assessment'.

scenes.motion: headline builds in word-by-word or clause reveal; breathing terracotta radial glow behind; large ghost-text texture at low opacity for depth

animated calendar/pages motif in terracotta line-art flips rapidly (real content visual, page count decreasing) then slams to a stop — the stop is the beat; text arrives synced to the stop, carried forward by scene 1's exit vector

scenes.text: Neurobelle gir deg nevrologisk spesialistvurdering — raskt.
scenes.motion: wordmark-led reveal continuing the same directional current as the calendar-stop exit; subtle single pulse/checkmark accent synced to 'raskt'; no idle wobble

scenes.text: Klinikk i Oslo / Eller video / Du velger
scenes.motion: three beats staggered in sequence with varied layout (not identical repeated cards) — building icon+label, then phone/video icon+label offset differently, then checkmark+label as the resolving beat; each beat's exit motivates the next entrance in the same current
hard cut to near-black stage-ground (seam-craft opaque background to avoid white-flash); wordmark lockup in Playfair Display, terracotta accent hairline, CTA in Montserrat resolves and holds to end
